input.comment: [Playbook] We must keep the freedom to source from other suppliers, so we have deleted the sole-and-exclusive provider obligation in Section 2.2; it also conflicts with Section 12.3's acknowledgement that we have made no exclusivity commitment. If some protection is needed we can discuss a 12-month, single-category exclusivity that ends automatically on any service-level failure.

input.summary: Extend licence to Affiliates/contractors and remove revocability at will
input.comment: [Playbook] A licence revocable at Vendor's sole discretion and excluding our Affiliates and contractors is not usable; we have extended it to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf and made revocation subject only to the uncured material breach standard already in Section 13.3.

ops.oldText: Vendor grants Customer alone a non-transferable licence, revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, to use the Services without Affiliates or contractors.
ops.newText: Vendor grants Customer, its Affiliates, and contractors acting on Customer's behalf a licence, transferable to a successor as permitted by Section 24 and revocable only in accordance with Section 13.3, to use the Services.
